username.description: New username. Whitespace is trimmed and letters are lowercased.

access_token.description: New access token for bearer authentication.

username.description: Username. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and letters are lowercased.

email.description: Account email. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and letters are lowercased.

refresh_token_revoked.description: Whether the supplied refresh token was revoked.

online.description: Whether the target user currently has an active connection

addresseeId.description: UUID of the user to send a friend request to.

target.description: Rounds to play (fixed-rounds) or score to reach (fixed-target-score).

mode.description: `fixed-target-score`: first to the target; drawn rounds are replayed. `fixed-rounds`: exactly the target number of rounds; draws count; can end drawn.

theme.description: How the game page looks. The queue ignores it.

powerUps.description: One shield and one double per player per match. Only players with the same choice are paired.

isDeleted.description: True of the opponent account has been soft-deleted.

friendshipId.description: Friendship row id, null when state is self or none.
